payload.title: mav duplicates the architect
payload.body: Answered in part by the persona concept: the generic architect is the role's holder with no residue, and mav is a persona whose residue is its archetype above the architect, so the two are not duplicates by definition. Still open for a future ideation round with the operator: what mav's residue is beyond its archetype, and whether the generic architect should be dispatchable at all, since the design is not delegable.
